name: Herugavialis
sum: Herugavialis is a marine gavialoid crocodylian from the Middle Eocene Mokattam Formation near Cairo, Egypt.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A skull lacking the premaxilla; catalogue number not given on the page.

author: Burke et al. 2026
